ABOUT College
ABOUT college
Established in 2018 by the RV Educational Institutions (RVEI), MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies (RVILS) was founded in response to the growing complexity of disputes, rising crime and emerging challenges such as cybercrime within an evolving legal landscape. Situated in Bengaluru, a leading centre for professional education, the Institute was conceived with a distinct and contemporary approach to legal training.
Renamed in honour of Dr. M.K. Panduranga Setty, President Emeritus of RSST, the institution reflects a legacy of service and academic responsibility. RVILS is affiliated with Karnataka State Law University (KSLU) and approved by the Bar Council of India (BCI).
The Institute offers the B.A., LL.B., B.B.A., LL.B. and B.Com., LL.B. 5-year integrated programmes, along with the 3-year LL.B. programme. It is committed to producing competent legal professionals capable of contributing meaningfully to the courts, the profession and society at large.

RV Educational Institutions (RVEI) was founded in 1940 by the late Sri M.C. Sivananda Sarma, on a conviction that education is not a privilege, but a right. What began as a single school has, over eight decades, grown into a network of 28+ institutions serving more than 24,000 students and supported by over 3,000 staff members. The academic framework spans kindergarten to postgraduate education across technology, health sciences, management, humanities, natural sciences, social sciences and legal studies.
RVEI has always believed that a well-rounded institution must serve a wide cross-section of society. That includes education for students with special needs and sustained outreach to the less privileged. Rural health camps and community awareness programmes reflect this commitment and further underscore that the institution’s responsibility does not end at its gates.
Its enduring motto, “Go, change the world”, is the standard RVEI has held itself to for over eight decades.

About the  Programme
The B.A. LL.B (5-year Integrated Degree) Programme combines legal education with humanities and social sciences, offering a structured pathway for students seeking to pursue careers in litigation, judiciary, civil services and public law.
The integrated curriculum provides grounding in constitutional and criminal law while fostering critical engagement with questions of governance, rights and social justice. This academic learning is supported by moot courts, internships and legal aid activities, ensuring practical exposure alongside doctrinal study.
Graduates of the programme are prepared for professional practice, judicial services examinations, civil services, academia and related roles within the legal profession.

Programme Outcomes
To allow students to explore a wide range of disciplines to develop a comprehensive understanding of society, politics, and culture, in addition to the law.
To provide students with an in-depth and comprehensive legal education that covers various aspects of law, including both general and specialised areas.
To foster a culture of legal research, scholarly writing and critical analysis, encouraging students to contribute to legal academia.
To equip students with the necessary skills and knowledge to excel in the legal profession, including legal practice, advocacy, and ethical conduct.
To expose students to International and Comparative Law, promoting a global perspective and understanding to legal systems beyond their jurisdiction.
To offer opportunities for students to specialise in specific areas of law, enabling them to develop expertise in fields such as Environmental Law, Intellectual Property, Human Rights or Corporate Law.
Programme Objectives
PO-1
Integrates legal studies with a broader liberal arts education, fostering a well-rounded understanding of the humanities, social sciences and cultural studies.
PO-2
Emphasises the intersection of law with subjects such as political science, sociology and economics, encouraging a holistic perspective on legal issues.
PO-3
Displays their comprehension and expertise in Substantive Law, Procedural Law and Constitutional Law.
PO-4
Builds proficiency in conducting legal analysis and reasoning, legal research, problem-solving, and written and oral communication in the legal context, enabling students to apply these skills in legal practice and real-life situations.
PO-5
Exhibits the professional skills essential for legal practice, including pleading, argument, drafting, conveyancing, collaboration, counselling and negotiation.
PO-6
Enhances the skill to analyse legal aspects in connection with contemporary developments at National and International levels.
PO-7
Demonstrates a thorough understanding of professional ethics and regulations, and showcases their practical application in the legal profession.
Eligibility Criteria
Academic Qualification
Candidates seeking admission to the 5-year B.A. LL.B. Integrated Degree Programme must have completed a Pre-University Course or Senior Secondary School Examination (10+2 pattern) from an institution recognised by the Central or State Government in India.
Applicants who have completed an equivalent qualification from a foreign institution recognised by the government of that country and recognised in India are also eligible to apply.
Admission shall be granted in accordance with the regulations of Karnataka State Law University, Hubballi.
Foreign Nationals
Foreign Nationals seeking admission are eligible, subject to the fulfilment of the prescribed eligibility conditions. The Admission Committee shall determine the equivalence of the qualifying examination for admission.

Teaching Methodology
The teaching methodology at RVILS combines rigorous doctrinal study with structured practical exposure, preparing students to apply legal principles in real-world situations with clarity and confidence.
Interactive Classroom Teaching
Classroom learning is rigorous and participative. Faculty members use case-law analysis, statutory interpretation, structured discussions, debates, problem-based learning and moot simulations to build critical reasoning and advocacy skills. Emphasis is placed on constitutional values and the application of law to contemporary issues.
Field Visits
To bridge theory and practical knowledge, organised visits are conducted to courts, tribunals, prisons, police stations, forensic laboratories, legislative bodies and legal aid centres. These engagements provide first-hand insight into the functioning of the justice delivery system and deepen understanding of procedural and institutional processes.
Nyaya Darpana Lecture Series
Through the Nyaya Darpana Lecture Series, eminent judges, senior advocates and academicians address emerging legal developments and landmark judgments, encouraging informed discourse beyond the syllabus.
Internships
Structured internships with advocates, law firms, corporate legal departments, NGOs, judicial offices and government institutions form an integral part of the programme. Through this experience, students gain practical insights into law and develop the confidence required for professional practice.
Certificate Courses
Short-term certification courses in areas such as intellectual property rights, mediation and legal drafting strengthen specialised skills and enhance professional preparedness.
Peer Tutoring
Under faculty supervision, senior students mentor juniors in research, drafting and moot preparation, creating a structured environment for academic growth.

Internship Frameworks
Internships form a compulsory component of the LL.B. programme and are an essential part of professional legal training. It ensures that students gain practical exposure throughout the 5-year and 3-year law courses.
As part of the internship requirement, students undertake internships in courts, law firms, corporate legal departments, regulatory authorities and non-governmental organisations.
This exposure enables students to understand the functioning of the legal system and develop skills relevant to litigation, corporate practice and public service.
During their law internships, students engage in legal research, drafting pleadings and opinions, preparing cases and observing court proceedings under academic supervision, in accordance with university regulations.

To enhance students' learning of a particular area of law.
To enable students to participate more effectively in law school classes to bring real-world experience back to the classroom.
To make students aware of career alternatives.
To further develop and integrate personal characteristics such as self-awareness problem-solving skills, professional ethics and behaviour.
To gain a better understanding of the relation of law to society, economics, psychology and social science to develop new knowledge and skills.

Community Extension Activities
Legal Services  Clinic
The Legal Services Clinic of MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies (RVILS) provides students with practical exposure to legal aid and community outreach activities. Under the guidance of faculty members, students participate in initiatives such as legal awareness programmes, legal aid camps, socio-legal surveys and educational visits to courts and legal institutions.
The Clinic also collaborates with organisations such as the District Legal Services Authority to conduct programmes that promote legal awareness among the public. These activities help students understand how law operates in real social contexts while encouraging a sense of professional responsibility towards access to justice.
Visit Legal
Services Clinic
Aim, Mission  & Objectives
Aim
To provide legal aid through human resource, knowledge resource & infrastructural resource to those who need it the most, purely on a pro- bono basis.
Mission
The Legal Services Clinic operates in line with the institutional commitment of RVILS towards social responsibility. It seeks to foster sensitivity to community issues, encourage meaningful engagement with society, and promote ethical, value-based legal education through practice and outreach.
Objectives
To promote legal awareness and literacy within the community
To organise legal aid and literacy programmes in collaboration with relevant authorities
To provide free legal assistance to socially and economically disadvantaged sections
To facilitate access to the justice system for those facing practical or financial barriers
To develop practical legal skills and professional competence among students
To support initiatives relating to legal policy and institutional frameworks in association with statutory bodies
To encourage a sense of responsibility towards legal and social issues
Services Provided by the Legal Services Clinic
Legal Literacy Programmes - Organisation of camps and awareness programmes in association with bodies such as DLSA, KLSA and NALSA, including outreach in villages, institutions and community spaces.
Legal Advice - Free legal consultation available on working days (Monday to Friday: 11:00 AM – 4:00 PM; Saturday: 11:00 AM – 1:30 PM.
Para-Legal Services - Assistance with drafting applications, documentation, and guidance on procedures relating to government services and legal forums.
Dispute Resolution - Facilitation of amicable settlement through mediation by faculty members, practising advocates and participation in Lok Adalats.
Training and Capacity Building - Organisation of seminars, workshops and training programmes to provide practical exposure to student members.

The Moot Court Academy trains students in courtroom advocacy through simulated court proceedings, memorial drafting and participation in moot court competitions. The Academy supports participation in inter-collegiate and National Moot Court competitions, helping students develop practical advocacy skills alongside their academic study of law.

Moot court training plays a significant role in shaping students into competent and confident legal professionals. Regular participation in moot court competitions offers practical exposure to courtroom procedure and advocacy, closely reflecting the functioning of real courts.
Through this process, students develop:
Strong analytical and reasoning abilities
Effective legal research skills
Clarity and precision in legal writing
Confidence in oral advocacy and structured argument
The ability to think critically under pressure
Professional discipline and time management
Awareness of courtroom etiquette and presentation
Opportunities for peer learning and professional interaction
A stronger academic profile through consistent participation
The ability to reflect on feedback and improve performance over time

Human Rights Cell
The Human Rights Cell at RVILS works to promote awareness and understanding of human rights among students. The cell organises lectures, discussions, competitions and outreach activities focusing on contemporary human rights issues at the National and International levels. Through these initiatives, students are encouraged to develop sensitivity towards issues of justice and equality while strengthening their commitment to constitutional values.
Vision:
To serve as a focal point for human rights engagement on campus, and to contribute towards a society where individuals recognise and uphold their responsibility to promote and protect human rights.
Mission:
To promote and protect human rights through institutional initiatives, awareness and capacity-building. The Cell works to encourage informed engagement with human rights issues, both within and beyond the campus, through education, training and responsible reporting of concerns.
OBJECTIVES:
To create awareness and understanding of human rights principles
To build sensitivity towards human rights issues within the campus and the wider community
To educate and train students on contemporary human rights concerns
To disseminate accurate and relevant information on human rights developments in India
To provide a platform for addressing human rights concerns within the institution
To study and examine human rights issues affecting the campus and its surroundings
To encourage respect for fundamental rights in all spheres of interaction
ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITY:
To foster an environment of mutual respect, dignity and inclusion
To discourage and address discrimination, harassment or unfair treatment
To promote awareness of individual and collective responsibilities in upholding human rights across differences of identity, belief and background

Alumni Testimonials
Hear from the graduates of MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies (RVILS) their journeys, transformations and reflections on five years of legal education, friendships and growth.
2020-2025 Batch
Aryan Shetty
B.B.A. LL.B.
“Looking back, RVILS gave me more than just a legal education. It gave me clarity, confidence, and community. What truly sets this college apart is its culture, from moot courts and scholarly discussions on contemporary legal topics with visiting scholars to the unwavering commitment of the faculty. The environment here constantly pushed me to grow, not just as a law student, but as a confident individual ready to face anything in the legal world. Every corner of this campus holds a lesson, a memory, or a mentor who shaped my journey. It’s here that I found my voice, learned to think fearlessly, and realised that law is a powerful tool to create meaningful change."
Taskeen Shaikh
B.A.LLB.
“I joined MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies in 2020 as a B.A., LL.B. student, and looking back, it’s been an amazing journey. When I first started, I was very shy and unsure of myself. But over the years, I slowly came out of my shell. I got involved in various activities, participated in moots, and even won a few competitions, which really boosted my confidence. The atmosphere at college always pushed me to do better and explore my potential beyond academics. What made my experience even better were the people around me. I made some great friends who stood by me through everything, and my teachers were always supportive and encouraging. They guided me not just in academics but throughout the entire course of my legal education. Today, I feel much more confident and outgoing than I was when I first walked into the campus. I’m grateful for the experiences and lessons over these five years, which have shaped my growth in the law field. ”
Harsha M.Talur
B.B.A. LL.B.
“Life is like a roller coaster; it is full of surprises, ups and downs, and twists and turns. However, life is great when it goes well. Our time in college is equally thrilling, with ups and downs akin to those on a roller coaster. College is a truly amazing and unexpected time in life when we make adult decisions about our future, make a lot of friends, decide on our majors, decide on our careers, and get ready for the challenges of the real world. My time at RV was an exciting and fulfilling one, the institute provided me with every opportunity to know and achieve my potential. It shaped me through to participate in numerous competitions, to give my best and win them. The infrastructure like library, digital library and other facilities has helped me to navigate throughout this journey. Additionally there are various committees in the college that helped me get involved in activities of my interests. ”
Ayushi Vyas
B.B.A. LL.B.
"My college has been a world in itself – vibrant, nurturing, and transformative. It has not only shaped my academic journey but also uplifted me as an individual. With unwavering support from faculty and a community that fosters growth, it has been a place where dreams take root and futures are built. I will always carry its spirit with pride and gratitude. "
Anirudh Ramesh P
B.A. LL.B.
“My time at MKPM RVILS has been nothing short of transformative. Beyond academic excellence, it has been a space for personal evolution, shaping my character, sharpening my skills, and instilling in me the confidence to take on the world. The opportunities, mentorship, and exposure I've received here have laid a strong foundation for my journey in the legal profession and beyond. I leave with deep gratitude and pride for having been a part of this incredible institution. ”
Gauri Kulkarni
“My journey at RVILS has been incredibly enriching, both academically and personally. The college offered me numerous opportunities from moots to extracurricular activities like music and dance and consistently encouraged me to grow by providing a platform to explore my interests. RVILS always motivated me to take part in competitions, and the constant support and guidance from the faculty played a key role in helping me balance academics, internships, mooting, and extracurricular pursuits. These experiences helped me gain confidence and discover my true potential. I am truly grateful to RVILS for the encouragement and platform it gave me to thrive.”
2019-2024 Batch
Rohit Kumar Choudhary
B.B.A. LL.B.
“Our time at RV Institute of Legal Studies has been a profound journey of intellectual challenge and personal development. From delving into intricate legal principles to forging deep connections with peers and mentors, each experience has enriched our understanding and prepared us for the future. As we transition to the next chapter of our professional lives, we carry with us the invaluable insights and lasting relationships that have marked our time here. This chapter has been a defining one, laying a strong foundation for our future endeavours.”
MOIZ ABDULLA
“Some of your good memories in your life are,which is created by you in your college days. My journey in college started with some,introvert feeling as the time pass, the college gave me an evergreen confidence which let me to boost my standards to rise and shine. The great teachers, who have put there huge efforts in making me a person of independent mind and a great leader which encourage me to be the best. And my dear friends, with whom I have made so many memories that include the smiles, emotional moments and the fight which was for each other's happiness, everything was like a dream which will always be fresh in my mind. Lastly, a big thank you to the college that granted me this life, which I couldn't have dreamt about.”
Bhumika D.S
B.B.A. LL.B.
“College life is considered a bridge in our lives between our school days and our career. It prepares us with the finest academics and a platform to generate dreams into realities. It acts as a transition to prepare us to be more independent. In school, we were dependent on our parents. However, we became independent in college regarding studying, travelling and decision-making and financially independent after college. It is a valued and very smooth transition where we do not realise that we have become independent.
I had enjoyed my college life to the fullest and had some of the best college days of my life. I am a student of one of the most reputed colleges of Bengaluru i.e, RV Institute Of Legal Studies. I have completed my BA.LLB. When I took admission to this college, I was really afraid as all the people were new to me. But soon, I started enjoying my college life and made some fantastic friends. I loved everything about my college and participated in the events at my college. I participated in many dance competitions that occurred in college. One of the best things about college life is that you get a new experience every day. In my college life, along with studying, I and my friends enjoyed a lot of other things. We travelled to lots of places, had new experiences, and learned many new things. Another thing I loved about my college life is the annual fests. Every year, our college organises an annual fest that lasts for 2-3 days. In this annual fest, various competitions happen, and students from various colleges come to be a part of this annual fest. Every year, our college organises a massive annual fest, and all the students of our college participate in various events and enjoy a lot in this fest. These fests allow students to socialise with new people and showcase their talent to everyone, which builds their confidence and helps them in their future. I have participated in my college & annual fest for all five years, and I have got the best exposure and experience of my life through this fest. I had the best time of my life in college, and my college life memories will always make me happy.”
Varshika Sai Kanala
B.B.A. LL.B.
“As I reflect on my 5-year long journey at RVILS, I am filled with gratitude for the opportunities and experiences which have shaped me into the individual I am today. The faculty members and management have always rendered to me their unwavering support in all academic, curricular and extra-curricular activities.
Their knowledge and support have been crucial in creating an environment that enabled me to grow holistically. Whether it was participating in moot court competitions, organising college events, or participating in conferences and seminars, each experience played a pivotal role in broadening my perspectives and helped me discover my full potential. I will always be immensely grateful to my classmates and friends who became an integral part of my journey, as we navigated challenges and celebrated our successes together, creating lifelong friendships.
As I stand at the end of my journey with this institution, I am filled with confidence knowing that RVILS has equipped me with not just a degree, but also with a robust set of leadership skills, legal knowledge and moral values that will serve as the foundation for all my future endeavours.”
Damodar M. Nayak
B.B.A. LL.B.
“RVILS has helped me tremendously over the past 5 years in shaping my career in a positive direction. I'm extremely grateful to the institution and the management for the opportunities provided to me and thankful to the faculty who have been there to help me whenever needed. I'm proud to have been part of the 2nd batch of an institution which I'm sure will reach greater heights in the nearest future. The success that RVILS has achieved in such a short amount of time is commendable and is second to none.”
Nimisha N
B.B.A. LL.B.
“My journey at MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies began in August 2019 when I embarked on the path of pursuing a BBA. LL.B. degree. Over these five years, I’ve experienced remarkable growth, both personally and academically. As I progressed, I delved deeper into the complexities of law, engaging in moot courts, internships, and legal research that broadened my understanding and sharpened my skills.
During my initial years I was scared and had stage fear, I was scared to speak infornt of the whole class. I held myself back but today I find myself more confident, can face the audience and ready to take up challenges. I reflect on these years with gratitude for the supportive faculty, the lessons learned, the friendships made, and the journey that has prepared me for the future.”
Ayushman Kumar B.
B.B.A. LL.B.
“My college experience at RVILS was a transformative journey that shaped me into a confident and independent individual. I cherished the opportunity to explore various interests, from academics to extracurricular activities. The support from professors and peers helped me grow. I developed essential skills like critical thinking, mooting and research skills and communication.
This institution has taught me to balance responsibilities, prioritize tasks, and manage time effectively. The memories I created – from late-night moot court preparations to laughter-filled moments with friends are etched in my heart forever.
College was a time of self-discovery, growth, and exploration. It has most definitely prepared me for the real world, equipping me with knowledge, skills, and a network of lifelong connections”.
Gururaja Udupa Baikady
B.B.A. LL.B.
“I, Gururaja Udupa Baikady, studying in the final year, would like to express a few words of experiences and gratitude towards the MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies.
During my five-year B.B.A. LL.B. Integrated Degree Course, I gained comprehensive knowledge in both business administration and law, equipping me to handle complex legal and business challenges. I honed critical thinking, legal research, and problem-solving skills through rigorous coursework and practical internships. My experience in moot courts, legal drafting, and case studies developed my ability to analyse and apply laws effectively. Exposure to business management principles and legal ethics further enhanced my decision-making and leadership capabilities. This dual expertise enables me to work efficiently and validate work with precision, ensuring accuracy and compliance in both legal and business contexts.
Thanks to all the teachers, staff members and Administration for the opportunities and memorable moments cherished in this institution”.
Shivani S.
B.B.A. LL.B.
"I express my utmost respect and heartfelt gratitude to my college for providing me with the rich learning experience throughout the course.
The wonderful academic support blended with constant motivation and guidance towards providing opportunities in co - curriculum, extra-curriculum, internships, sports and cultural events have helped me gain deep and invaluable insights and made me a strong and independent law student. The infrastructure facilities are state-of-the-art, and the digital and physical libraries are the places where I could acquire a huge amount of knowledge and exposure. I express with pride and utmost gratitude that I have gained a significant personal and professional growth that could be possible only by the constant support and unconditional guidance of our Principal. The continuous support of the teaching and non-teaching staff and each and every member of RVILS is truly priceless for me. My fellow batchmates have made my journey during the golden time of student life even more memorable and joyful.
I feel extremely blessed, happy and proud of being a student of RVILS and will be thankful towards our Institution for my lifetime for preparing us with such concern and compassion for our future pursuits."
Shreyas D
B.B.A. LL.B.
“My five years at MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies have been transformative. Moving to Bangalore was a new chapter, but the institute quickly became a place where I could grow and thrive. The support from the faculty and the encouragement to engage in NCC, moot court competitions and research projects enriched my learning experience. Winning the Best Researcher award in an international moot court competition is a testament to the guidance I received here.
Beyond academics, the friendships and bonds formed with my classmates have made this journey truly unforgettable. As I graduate, I am deeply thankful for the support and encouragement from my teachers and the principal, who have prepared me for the future with confidence and purpose”.

MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies Celebrates 8th Foundation Day and Hosts 2nd Alumni Meet with a Spectacular Musical Evening
Date: 30 June, 2026
MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies successfully celebrated its 8th Foundation Day along with the 2nd Alumni Meet on 30th June 2026 at the Mangala Mantapa, MKPM RVILS Campus . The event brought together alumni, faculty members, students, and staff in a joyous celebration of the institution’s remarkable journey, achievements, and enduring legacy.
The programme served as a platform to reconnect with alumni, strengthen institutional bonds, and celebrate the growth and accomplishments of the MKPM RVILS family over the past eight years. Alumni from different graduating batches reminisced about their memorable experiences at the institution, shared their professional journeys, and inspired the current students with their success stories.
Adding vibrancy to the celebrations, the evening featured an enthralling live musical performance by the VORTEX Band , whose energetic and captivating performance created a lively atmosphere. The band’s dynamic repertoire of music entertained the audience and made the Foundation Day and Alumni Meet a memorable occasion filled with enthusiasm, nostalgia, and celebration.
The event reflected the institution’s commitment to fostering lifelong relationships with its alumni while celebrating the spirit of excellence, unity, and community that defines MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies.
The management, faculty, staff, students, and alumni collectively commemorated this significant milestone, reaffirming their shared vision of academic excellence and professional integrity.
Orientation Session for the 36th YMCA Model Parliament Competition
Date: 01 sep, 2025
An orientation session for the 36th YMCA Model Parliament Competition was conducted on 1st September, 2025, and led by RVILS alumnus Mr. Chinmayee.
The session introduced students of MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies (RVILS) to the structure and procedures of the Model Parliament, offering insights into parliamentary functioning and legislative processes. Drawing from his experience, Mr. Chinmayee guided students on debating techniques, drafting motions and maintaining parliamentary decorum during parliamentary proceedings.
The interactive session provided students with a practical understanding of the competition and encouraged participation in Model Parliament and legislative simulation activities.
